cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(doa2u_game C)

# Dead or Alive 2 Ultimate - recompiled game executable

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Generated by: py -3 -m tools.recomp ../doa2ugamefiles/DOA2.xbe --all --split 1000
#               py -3 -m tools.recomp.postprocess
file(GLOB RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/recomp/gen/recomp_*.c"
)

# NV2A GPU register emulation + PGRAPH -> D3D11 translator
set(NV2A_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/nv2a")
set(NV2A_SOURCES
    ${NV2A_DIR}/nv2a_core.c
    ${NV2A_DIR}/nv2a_mmio_hook.c
    ${NV2A_DIR}/nv2a_pb_test.c
    ${NV2A_DIR}/nv2a_pgraph_d3d11.c
    ${NV2A_DIR}/nv2a_vertex_program.c
)

set(GAME_SOURCES
    main.c
    movie_present.c
    video_settings.c
    log_settings.c
    host_stubs.c             # inert stand-ins for the DOA3 overlay/online hooks in d3d8
    recomp/recomp_manual.c
    burnout_compat_stubs.c   # inert stubs for burnout-only symbols the nv2a srcs need
    ${NV2A_SOURCES}
    ${RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES}
)

add_executable(doa2u ${GAME_SOURCES})

target_link_libraries(doa2u PRIVATE
    xbox_kernel
    d3d8_compat
    dsound_compat
    input_compat
    apu_emu
    kernel32
    user32
    gdi32
    d3d11
    dxgi
)

target_include_directories(doa2u PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/recomp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/recomp/gen
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party
    ${NV2A_DIR}
)

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(doa2u PRIVATE
        /W3
        /WX-
        $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:/O2>
        $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:/Ob2>
        $<$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>:/O2>
    )
    set_property(TARGET doa2u PROPERTY MSVC_RUNTIME_CHECKS "")
    set_source_files_properties(${RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES} recomp/recomp_manual.c
        PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "/w /bigobj")
    set_source_files_properties(${NV2A_SOURCES} PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "/w")
    target_compile_definitions(doa2u PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
    # Fixed image base (Xbox memory is mapped at fixed addresses); each guest
    # call/ret is a native call/return, so the stack is large.
    target_link_options(doa2u PRIVATE
        /DYNAMICBASE:NO
        /FIXED:NO
        /MAP
        $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:/DEBUG>
        $<$<CONFIG:Release>:/SUBSYSTEM:WINDOWS>
        $<$<CONFIG:Release>:/ENTRY:mainCRTStartup>
        /STACK:33554432
        /LARGEADDRESSAWARE
    )
endif()

set_target_properties(doa2u PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME "DOA2U"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/debug"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/release"
    PDB_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/debug"
)
